notesI18n.zh:
· 会话列表新增三种视图：单目录 / 收藏夹 / 全部目录，点左上角按钮切换
· 「全部目录」跨所有工作目录展示会话（本版本起新建的会话自动建索引）
· 会话列表支持分页：默认 20 条，滚到底自动加载更多；搜索仍搜全部
· 顶栏图标全部换成手绘单色 SVG，风格统一
notesI18n.en:
· Session list now has three views: current directory / favorites / all directories
· "All directories" spans every workspace (sessions created from this version on are auto-indexed)
· Session list is paginated: 20 by default, auto-loads more on scroll; search still covers everything
· Sidebar icons redrawn as a consistent set of monochrome SVGs
